steps.text: [ "${RHEL_VERSION}" == "" ] && source /etc/os-release && RHEL_VERSION=${VERSION_ID}; echo ${RHEL_VERSION} > /etc/dnf/vars/releasever && echo -e "best=True\ninstall_weak_deps=False" >> /etc/dnf/dnf.conf

dnf -y install kernel-devel${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-devel-matched${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-headers${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-modules${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-modules-extra${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION}

if [ $(arch) = x86_64 ]; then dnf -y install kernel-rt-devel${RT_KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${RT_KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-rt-modules${RT_KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${RT_KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-rt-modules-extra${RT_KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${RT_KERNEL_VERSION}; diff --side-by-side <(rpm -qi kernel-core | grep 'Source RPM') <(rpm -qi kernel-rt-core | grep 'Source RPM'); fi

if [ $(arch) = aarch64 ]; then dnf -y install kernel-64k-devel${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-64k-modules${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION} kernel-64k-modules-extra${KERNEL_VERSION:+-}${KERNEL_VERSION}; fi
dnf -y install kernel-rpm-macros
dnf -y install autoconf automake binutils elfutils-libelf-devel glibc kabi-dw kmod libtool

export INSTALLED_KERNEL=$(rpm -q --qf "%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}" kernel-devel) && GCC_VERSION=$(cat /lib/modules/${INSTALLED_KERNEL}/config | grep -Eo "gcc \(GCC\) ([0-9\.]+)" | grep -Eo "([0-9\.]+)") && dnf -y install gcc-${GCC_VERSION} gcc-c++-${GCC_VERSION} || dnf -y install gcc gcc-c++
dnf -y install xz diffutils flex bison
dnf -y install git make rpm-build
if [ $(arch) == "x86_64" ] || [ $(arch) == "aarch64" ]; then ARCH_DEP_PKGS="mokutil"; fi && dnf -y install openssl keyutils $ARCH_DEP_PKGS
dnf clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/dnf/*
/manifests/01-openshift-imagestream.yaml
/manifests/image-references
if echo "${TAGS:-}" | grep -q scos > /dev/null 2>&1; then sed -i 's/rhel-coreos/stream-coreos/g' /manifests/*; fi
io.k8s.description io.openshift.os.streamclass io.openshift.release.operator kernel-rt-version kernel-version name version

export INSTALLED_KERNEL=$(rpm -q --qf "%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}" kernel-devel); export INSTALLED_RT_KERNEL=$(rpm -q --qf "%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}+rt" kernel-rt-core); echo "{ \"KERNEL_VERSION\": \"${INSTALLED_KERNEL}\", \"RT_KERNEL_VERSION\": \"${INSTALLED_RT_KERNEL}\", \"RHEL_VERSION\": \"$(</etc/dnf/vars/releasever)\" }" > /etc/driver-toolkit-release.json
